## Problem and intended value

Explain who would benefit and what problem the proposal addresses.

## Proposed change

Describe the idea and its boundaries. Proposals are not approved commitments.

## Alternatives and tradeoffs

Describe other approaches and any data, licensing, or technical constraints.

## Open questions

Identify decisions that require the project owner's input. Substantial code contributions should wait until licensing and the implementation approach are clarified.
